approved_scope.title: Append-only event corrections with chough correct, never rewriting history (#167)

acceptance_criteria: chough correct <event> --reason appends a correction event naming its EVT- target with the corrected statement in the active session's current cycle; the target's bytes are unchanged; unknown ids, blank or oversized statements and correcting a correction are refused with nothing written; next and status show the correction with its target; timing treats the kind as known with no stage segment.
